description: Find films, TV series, books and video games in the Boxlist catalogue by name (books also by author). Returns each title's boxlist.com page and a `ref` to pass to the other Boxlist tools. Use it to pin down the right title (e.g. which "Dune") before asking for a taste profile or similar titles.

media.description: Restrict to these media: "film", "tv", "book", "game". Omit for all four.

query.description: Title or part of it, optionally with a year ("Dune 2021"). Books also match by author.

name: search_titles

attribution.description: Required credit: show "Data from Boxlist" with the link wherever these results are used.

anyOf.description: One follow-up link worth offering the user (show it as a single line).

blurb.description: Short description when available (books and games).

creator.description: Author for books, developer for games.

match.description: How well the name matched the query.

ref.description: Stable reference; pass it back to other Boxlist tools as `title` (e.g. "tv/Succession-2018").

url.description: Canonical boxlist.com page. Always show or link this.

title: Search Boxlist titles
